data_handling.missingness_policy: Do not interpolate missing months. Preserve and report missing values or gaps.
data_handling.preprocessing_policy: Preserve the exact raw source snapshot and its SHA-256. Generate the date,value analysis file deterministically from that snapshot; do not modify the raw file.
data_handling.normalization_policy: Use repository normalization only after the raw snapshot, monthly cadence, missingness, and eligibility checks pass.
